title: Prompt orbit story with a guided light trail
summary: A soft orb carries one continuous story from a portrait into a typed prompt, an orbiting media mosaic, short claims, selectable outputs, and a restrained mark close.
use_when: a 20–30 s launch film led by one visual guide
a creative tool that turns one input into several outputs
a brand story that needs media examples without full product UI
a light-background film with continuous morph transitions

look.type_style: regular grotesk, sentence case, neutral tracking, 4–8 % of frame height

sfx.event: media tiles arrive around the claim
output label changes beside the check

structure.shot: a pastel orb grows at the centre of a thin construction grid on white
structure.motion: orb scales from a point with springs.cameraIn over ~38 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the orb becomes a rounded portrait card that expands to the grid's central frame
structure.motion: circular mask opens into a rounded card with springs.layout over ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a small mark replaces the portrait; its short wordmark types beside it, then compresses
structure.motion: mark logo-from-dot with springs.snappy ~12 fr (±0.25 s); wordmark typewriter over ~22 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the wordmark stretches into an outlined prompt pill and types a short introduction
structure.camera: fixed frame; pill width grows 0.00→0.50 W across ~15 fr (±0.25 s)
structure.motion: pill grows with springs.layout ~15 fr (±0.25 s); prompt-typing at ~14 characters/s

structure.shot: eight rounded media tiles form a loose ring around a centred four-word capability claim
structure.camera: pull-out 1.32→0.82 over 105 fr while the ring fills the frame
structure.motion: tiles orbit-ring in, stagger ~4 fr (±0.25 s), springs.pop ~15 fr; claim fades in over ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the media ring collapses to the pastel orb, which contracts, rebounds, and drops toward the next line
structure.motion: ring contracts with easings.inExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s); orb rebounds on springs.pop ~22 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the orb traces a thin curved line beneath two successive short process statements
structure.camera: dolly right about 98 px/s at 1920 reference width, then settles
structure.motion: first statement enters with easings.outExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s); orb follows a 60 fr curve

structure.shot: a second compact process statement replaces the first while the orb completes another arc
structure.motion: statement-sequence swap with springs.ui ~8 fr (±0.25 s); orb arc runs 38 fr

structure.shot: a five-word creation instruction types from the right and recentres; a checked output appears
structure.camera: dolly up about 147 px/s at 1920 reference width, then hold
structure.motion: instruction word-reveal with easings.outExpo ~15 fr (±0.25 s); check pops on springs.ui ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the checked output label cycles through three deliverable types as the orb repeats broad arcs
structure.camera: fixed frame; guide orb crosses ~0.65 W on each 38–60 fr arc
structure.motion: word-swap at 18.50, 18.77, and 19.27; springs.ui ~8 fr each (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the portrait card returns large inside the grid, then shrinks rapidly to a tiny central tile
structure.motion: card settles on springs.layout ~12 fr (±0.25 s), then exits with easings.inExpo ~18 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a small mark resolves at centre, its short wordmark types beside it, and the lockup holds on white
structure.camera: fixed frame; mark shifts ~0.08 W left as the wordmark grows, then holds
structure.motion: mark logo-from-dot with springs.snappy ~12 fr (±0.25 s); wordmark typewriter over ~22 fr (±0.25 s); hold 67 fr

params.brand: any brand.json; the light paper uses brand fg, ink uses brand bg, and media uses both accents
params.content.portraitLabel: short original label inside the abstract portrait card
params.content.mediaTiles: exactly eight short labels for abstract supporting media tiles
params.content.capability: one centred capability claim, exactly 4 short words
params.content.statements: three process or benefit lines, 4–7 words each
params.content.outputLabels: three short deliverable names, 1–2 words each
params.orbPalette: optional two or three brand-compatible colours for the guide orb and trail
params.timing.speed: global cadence multiplier; 1 preserves the measured 26.01 s structure
params.fps: composition fps; every structure boundary scales from seconds

notes: No detected hard or soft cuts; the film is a continuous chain of morphs. Boundaries are visible state changes at 0.25 s sheet resolution. The curved orb trail is a proposed term, not a recipe technique id. Demo media are abstract brand-colour tiles, never reference images. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured. cut_on_beat is false because there are no cuts (0/0).
